acceptance: Company context saves as USER_PROVIDED with durable content_status UNVERIFIED, exact source attribution, content SHA256, and a version bound to one existing company source.

Source identity is eligible only when one uniquely ranked persisted verified company domain exists and both the source career URL host and user-entered context URL host are under it. Accepted verification methods come from services.company_discovery.domains.VERIFIED_METHODS. No URL is fetched.
Approval requires an explicit user review, matching content SHA256, and a fresh source-identity check. An unverified or cross-company source cannot be approved or used.

Only the newest context version for the exact company-feed source linked to a job can be selected. A newer unreviewed version, ambiguous domain, mismatched source, or changed content suppresses context use.

A generated letter labels company text USER_PROVIDED and CONTENT UNVERIFIED, cites the source URL, and stores its reviewed context in the immutable job/document generation snapshot. Later context changes create a new document version; prior validated history survives database reopen.
